blocks.text: Greenway Townhomes South Surrey: the housing stock

items.t: Greenway is the second phase of Adera's South Ridge Club, a collection of 67 townhomes in 3- and 4-bedroom plans ranging from 1,550 to just under 2,000 square feet, per the developer.
Every Greenway home has private outdoor space of up to 750 square feet, including a private rooftop lanai and deck space, per Adera.

The City's February 22, 2016 planning report for 2825 159 Street proposed rezoning from Acreage Residential (RA) to a Comprehensive Development (CD) zone based on RM-30 to permit exactly 67 townhouse units, with Greenway Adera Ventures Ltd. as owner.

The shared amenity is the South Ridge Club clubhouse, described by Adera as a 6,500 square foot building with an outdoor pool, hot tub, kitchen, lounge, exercise room, full-size gymnasium and movie theatre.

blocks.text: Greenway Townhomes South Surrey: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Greenway is a strata purchase, so the Form B and depreciation report govern the diligence — stratas with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report on a five-year cycle and can no longer defer it by vote.

The site-specific CD zoning, not a standard townhouse zone, is what permits Greenway's form — a buyer checking additions or exterior changes starts from the CD bylaw and the strata bylaws, not from a generic Surrey townhouse rule.

blocks.text: Greenway Townhomes South Surrey: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Adera puts South Ridge Club within walking distance of the shops and restaurants at Grandview Corners, at 160 Street and 24 Avenue — the commercial core the Grandview plans were built around.
The presentation centre for the later South Ridge Club phase was at 15928 Mountain View Drive, on the same Grandview bench — the phases sit together, not scattered across South Surrey.

Greenway's zoning amendment bylaw, Surrey Zoning Bylaw Amendment Bylaw 2016 No. 18667, was finally adopted on May 16, 2016, after Council asked staff to review neighbourhood traffic circulation — traffic was a live condition of this project's approval.
Rooftop lanais mean the roof membrane over each unit is also a lived-on deck surface — a depreciation-report item specific to this design, not generic townhouse wear.

blocks.text: Greenway Townhomes South Surrey: development and new projects

items.t: Greenway at South Ridge Club — 2825 159 Street, Surrey; developer Adera (Greenway Adera Ventures Ltd.); townhomes, 67 homes as stated in the City planning report and the developer's release; status: completed development, rezoning adopted May 16, 2016 (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Greenway Townhomes South Surrey: costs and taxes

items.t: No strata fee figure is stated here — fees are strata-specific and are read off the Form B for the unit being bought.

blocks.text: Greenway Townhomes South Surrey: getting around

items.t: Route 354 is the direct Grandview bus — TransLink's timetable shows it running Bridgeport Station to White Rock South via 160 Street, 24 Avenue and 32 Avenue, serving the 160 Street and 24 Avenue corner below Greenway.
Highway 99 access is via 24 Avenue and 32 Avenue interchanges west of the development — the corridor the Sunnyside Heights plan area borders.

blocks.text: Greenway Townhomes South Surrey: risks and due diligence

items.t: Read the depreciation report for rooftop-deck membranes, because Greenway's signature outdoor space sits on the roof assembly.
Check the Form B insurance summary for the water-damage deductible and any approved-but-unpaid special levy before subject removal.
Confirm how South Ridge Club clubhouse costs are allocated in the strata documents — the amenity is shared across phases, per the developer.

blocks.text: At South Ridge Club, the Greenway townhome complex is all about its shared clubhouse. It attracts three groups: families moving up from a condo, downsizers who want the clubhouse lifestyle, and Southridge school families.

faq.q: Is Greenway one phase or part of something larger?
faq.a: It is one phase of a larger club development. Adera describes Greenway as the second release of homes at South Ridge Club, following Willsbrook and preceding the Grandview phase, so owners share the South Ridge Club clubhouse and amenities with the sister phases rather than owning a standalone complex amenity building of their own.

faq.q: How big are the Greenway homes and outdoor spaces?
faq.a: The developer states 3- and 4-bedroom homes from 1,550 to just under 2,000 square feet. Each home carries private outdoor space of up to 750 square feet, including a private rooftop lanai — that rooftop space is the defining layout feature here and the item to inspect closely for membrane, drainage and railing condition on a resale purchase.

faq.q: What does the clubhouse actually include?
faq.a: Adera describes a 6,500 square foot members-only clubhouse with an outdoor pool, hot tub, barbecue area, kitchen, lounge, exercise room, a full-size gymnasium and a movie theatre. Because the amenity is shared across the South Ridge Club phases, a buyer should confirm in the strata documents how clubhouse costs are shared and who may use it.

Catchments in School District 36 (SD36) are address-based, so the exact unit address must be run in the district locator. Grandview Heights Secondary is at 16987 25 Avenue in the same plan area; do not rely on a listing's school line — confirm the catchment for 2825 159 Street itself before an offer that depends on a school.
